messages:
maria g: quick follow-up from last night's repeated redis pages. need owners + short ETAs so we don't wake oncall again.
maria g: root cause: rapid shard resync + low sustain on several shard alerts. proposed small actions below, please claim one.
  1) migrate dedupe to stable shard fingerprint (avoid instance)
  2) add short repage blocker (10m) for same dedupe_key
  3) bump sustain windows for shard alerts and add brief backoff
  4) routing tweak: warnings -> ops-queue unless sustained >120s
please reply with owner + ETA (date or "today EOD").
noel f: i'll take 1. will swap `instance` -> `{{ $labels.shard }}:{{ $labels.zone }}` and add a small unit test. ETA: Tue EOD (2026-06-02).
sophie_r: i'll own 2. plan: broker-side bloom filter to block repages for 10m per dedupe_key. will add tests and staging flip. ETA: tomorrow AM (2026-05-30).
devon: i'll do 3 and 4. config PR to set `for: 90s` -> `for: 180s` for shard rules and route warnings to #ops-queue by default. will include a feature flag for quick rollback. ETA: Mon AM (2026-06-01).
alert-bot: Silence set by devon for #pager-duty from 2026-05-30T23:10Z until 2026-05-31T08:00Z for rollout testing.
noel f: small dedupe snippet for clarity:
```yaml
labels:
  dedupe_key: "{{ $labels.shard }}:{{ $labels.zone }}"
```
this should be stable across instance renames.
sophie_r: bloom idea pseudocode:
```
if seen(dedupe_key): suppress_repage()
else: record(dedupe_key, ttl=10m); emit_pager()
```
devon: routing snippet i'll propose:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: severity == "warning"
    action: route_to_ops_queue
    escalate_if: sustained_for > 120s
``` 
maria g: can each owner drop a one-liner ETA so I can add to the PM tracker?
noel f: ETA Tue EOD (2026-06-02) - PR + tests.
sophie_r: ETA 2026-05-30 AM - broker patch + staging validation.
devon: ETA 2026-06-01 AM - config PR + feature flag.
maria g: after deploy we'll run a 48h noise-check and post 24/48h summaries here. who can own the monitor job?
sophie_r: i'll run the monitor and post 24/48h results.
noel f: i'll validate dedupe in staging before flip.
devon: ops will watch the first 2 hours after flip and post any anomalies.
maria g: blockers? please call them out now.
sophie_r: none.
noel f: infra ok for staging, no blockers.
devon: none.
maria g: great. i'll update the postmortem tracker and schedule a 15m check-in next Wed to confirm closure. reopen thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:
